Costume: Display Tanino Gimlet (Casual Wear)

...Suddenly, I felt a burning heat in the palms of my hands.
My heart pounded, and perhaps because of it, my face—no, my entire body was flushed.

Had I failed to quicken a single beat of your pulse,
...I would have delivered my second refusal right now. In other words—

Surging up with tremendous momentum on the outside! Symboli Kris S—
and Tanino Gimlet! Less than 200 meters to go!

"Surely that's impossible," whispered the murmurings of the watching Trainers,
that skeptical atmosphere hanging thick in the air—yet...

(I shall not repeat history!
I will never accept eternal recurrence—!)
Naturally, my Trainer must be a talent capable of being intoxicated by me above all others!

Whether or not one would call this "intoxication"—
this surging excitement within me was unmistakably her doing.

And they're off!
Tanino Gimlet settles into the middle of the pack.

She tilted an invisible glass gently toward the heavens. Where she directed her gaze,
almost making me wonder if even this was part of her performance—

I hear Tanino Gimlet, who just ran in that mile race, is competing too.
Impressive that she got into condition in such a short window.

Heh... Then I shall become the Goddess of the Moon!
Race across the night sky, unleash lunar arrows upon the turf...!
—It is a little too early for a Gimlet.

No barrier stands in her path ahead.
Her lips curve into an arch. Her eyes gleam, her stride drives deep into the turf, and—

Since that day, I began spotting Tanino Gimlet
training with fierce dedication once more.

—...In other words, from that day forth,
I honed my strength and speed with that dazzling, fleeting brilliance as my base.

Run... Run, run! It is far too early for the peace of the abyss...!!
Ahhahahahahaha!!
Look upon yourself. What else could you call that but intoxication?

Perhaps because I had watched her efforts so closely these past days...
Before I knew it, my anticipation had turned into a prayer.

She was a hard worker—sprinting straight ahead toward the self she dreamed of since childhood,
striving tirelessly to seize the glorious crown she discovered along the way.

Then naturally, the personal Trainer who stands at my side
must be the most thoroughly intoxicated of all...!
I suddenly recalled the words Tanino Gimlet had spoken before.
You have come. And... ho.
Hmph!!

With that, she suddenly reached a hand up toward the sky.
Twisting her fingertips gently, as if holding a glass.

Yeah. Could she be trying for the pre-MC rotation?
If she produces results here too, she's an extraordinary talent. But... you know.

While the lead pack led by Symboli Kris S fought for position on the inside,
Tanino Gimlet unleashed a furious late charge—
Daaaaaaahhhhhhhh!!

Congratulations.
You possess the talent to be intoxicated by me.
And brilliantly seized first place!

Turning around at the call, Tanino Gimlet stared intently into my eyes
with an inexplicably triumphant, knowing look.

Heh-heh...! If you understand, accept it with reverence.
You are Tanino Gimlet's dedicated Trainer!

From the outside, it's Tanino Gimlet! Tanino Gimlet!
Tanino Gimlet breaks away—

A middle-distance mock race featuring an Umamusume with that kind of resolve. What sort of performance will she deliver?
That anticipation grew stronger by the day...!

A racing pulse, rising body temperature—a second trainer contract offer made after throwing reason to the wind.
All because you drank in Tanino Gimlet herself... Am I wrong?

To the MC rotation, impossible to conquer without not just sheer effort but overwhelming talent,
she stood closest of all, even without a trainer.

The newest aesthetic, the conquest of the MC rotation.
Walking beside her, it is no mere dream...!

Casting all restraint aside, I bolted from the stands and rushed to her side.
Before I knew it, rain had begun to fall upon the turf.

Now, do you see?! A toast to this sky!
May this long odyssey be filled with supreme destruction and bitters...!

...The ideal self I envision is the fleeting brilliance that intoxicates the world,
its very living avatar.

『Then there is only one thing left to do.
I shall give you a twist.』
Daaaaaaahhhhhhhhh!!

Tanino Gimlet circles wide from mid-pack, surging toward the leaders!
Around the fourth corner, she breaks into the final stretch!
She crosses the wire!

—The genius speed I witnessed the other day.
And the stamina and power displayed today that matched it in every measure.

Perhaps all the dramatic theatrics since then were merely a prelude
to test whether I was a Trainer worthy of succumbing to her spell.

As if to avoid the trouble of last time, coming out of the fourth corner,
Tanino Gimlet made a smooth, deliberate move to the outside!

Her performance at the mile was sensational, yeah... But at this distance,
I don't know. Stamina's gonna be put to the test.

—... The heavens weep. Weeping with delight at my victory...!
Fufu! Ahhahahahahaha!!
—At last, the long-awaited mock race began.
—Fufu! Ahhahahahahaha!!

............
—Heh... Judgment has been rendered.

Hearing her words the other day finally made me understand.
At a glance, Tanino Gimlet seems to simply have an intense personal flair, but—

Symboli Kris S sat forward in the middle of the pack, while Tanino Gimlet
settled toward the rear of it, steadily advancing through the race. And then—

Before I could finish speaking, she took my right hand
and... gently pressed my wrist against her ear.

...Today's middle-distance mock race sounds interesting.
I heard Symboli Kris S is running.

Ha, ha, ha, ha!
—The sun god too has returned to his eastern palace...!
A magnificent rainbow stretched across the sky.
—And then came the day of the mock race.
